integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact ideal-to-horizontal/central/lift correspondence, linear Goursat lemma and finite Grassmannian counting.
integrity.originality_scope: All linear Lie ideals, complete dimension enumerator, and reduced smooth parameter strata.
integrity.verification: Standalone exhaustive direct-bracket checker with seven finite-field configurations; not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Classifies ideals of complete-bipartite graphical two-step Lie algebras, not arbitrary graph Lie algebras.
The geometric claim applies to reduced locally closed strata, not to full scheme structures or global irreducible components.
The verification program exhaustively checks only the listed small finite fields and part sizes.
Historical priority remains provisional; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Complete ideal census and smooth Goursat strata for bipartite graphical Lie algebras
